drop.has: until band widths reach $100 for btc and $5 for gold

words: superseded by R287 - Love Oct 30 2026 9:23 PM PT: "The 3 PM rule is old. Remove it. My only limit was: bands wider than $100 BTC or $5 gold. After that, pink (and the other walls) are valid rejections at every hour. No 3 PM cutoff. No indefinite hold."
